newsitem.title: UK: BG faces five bln pound asset writedown-paper.
newsitem.headline: BG faces five bln pound asset writedown-paper.

text.p: BG Plc, owner of the pipeline network of the former British Gas Plc, could face a five billion pound writedown of its assets, The Times newspaper said.
The paper said the Monopolies and Mergers Commission was likely to adopt the valuation of its Transco pipeline made by Ofgas, the industry regulator, which stood at 12.5 billion pounds.
The book value of Transo's assets has been recorded as 18 billion pounds in its current cost accounts.
The Times said BG's management had not decided what it would do to its balance sheet once MMC formally approved Ofgas' valuation and was in talks with its auditors, Price Waterhouse.
The cost of sustaining Transco's 2,500 km of pipelines and other facilities has been the centre of a long dispute between Ofgas and the regulator.
BG and Ofgas are also in dispute over gas pricing rules and is awaiting a decision from the Monopolies and Mergers Commission.
